question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

AUSTERE
solution:
The correct answer is: Unadorned

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Austere means to be very simple; without decoration.

 
 
• Example - *Despite their wealth, they lead an **austere **life.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Unadorned means lacking embellishment or decoration: plain and simple.
 
 
• Example - *An **unadorned **Christmas tree is just a plain old pine tree.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Austere' and 'Unadorned' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Luxurious **means very comfortable; full of expensive and beautiful things.
 
• **Decorative **means attractive or pretty to look at.
 
• **Elaborate **means to add more information or explain something that you have said.
